title: Acute Effects of Exercise in the Heat: Expert Consensus Statement on Recognition, Management, and Prevention of Exertional Heat Illness (ACSM, 2021)
publisher: PubMed / Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise
claims: The consensus statement sets out recognition, management and prevention guidance for exertional heat illness during physical activity in the heat.
Heat illness risk rises when exercise intensity, environmental heat load and individual susceptibility combine; acclimatization, hydration and cooling are prevention measures.
Suspected exertional heat stroke requires immediate action: stop exercise, cool aggressively and call for emergency medical support.
